verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs show native tool calling: the OpenAI functions/tools API works across multiple backends, and an autoparser detects the tool-call format for tool-trained gguf models with no configuration. Nothing in the pack covers reasoning-parser support (e.g., separating reasoning or thinking content), so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: any documentation of reasoning-parser support, independent or hands-on confirmation of tool-call parsing, and details of which backends support tool calls.
